normal.title: ONC 548.9 nm reflectance map
normal.summary: Corrected 548.9 nm reflectance, stretched for display; the poles were not observed.

enhanced.title: ONC false-color composite
enhanced.summary: False colors show differences between images; the values are not measured reflectance.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 448 m sphere. The outline is simplified.

close-up.title: Hayabusa2 ONC MASCOT-operation mosaic
close-up.summary: Boulders across Ryugu’s equatorial strip, imaged during MASCOT deployment, with their original lighting.

thermal-inertia.title: Hayabusa2 TIR thermal inertia map
thermal-inertia.summary: How slowly the surface heats and cools, from a thermal model; higher means slower. Not a temperature map.

spectral-slope.title: Hayabusa2 ONC b–x spectral slope map
spectral-slope.summary: Reflectance change from blue to near-infrared; positive is redder. Not terrain slope or minerals.
